backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date: VIXY, SPY, and QQQ daily return/range context plus stock leadership, liquidity, close-location, volume, ret5/ret20/ret60, and realized-vol fields. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

data_coverage.source: Yahoo Finance mirror of ICE BofA MOVE Index

fingerprint_caveat: Reservation overmatched forward_replacement_value; this experiment adds the dedicated move_rate_volatility key and rebuilds frozen families.

runtime_fields: ICE BofA MOVE daily Close with 20-session history

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The volatility-relief leadership source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: volatility-premium compression confirmed by SPY/QQQ relief may identify stock leaders before the next session fully reprices the risk-on move.

2_history_check.exp-20260605-033: Cross-section pressure resilience failed across all windows; this tests relief after volatility compression, not stress resilience during selloff pressure.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-004/005: Broad recent-winner continuation failed tail/drawdown; this requires explicit VIXY/SPY/QQQ relief state.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-019/020: Official macro relief stock leadership was accepted as a shared adapter; this does not retune it and uses a different cross-asset volatility state instead of event-calendar days.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-027: Macro stress resilient leadership failed with thin sample and negative EV; this tests risk relief rather than stress.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, no window may regress EV/PnL, target sample must be >=20 across all 3 windows, survival must stay >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass.

hypothesis: ranking/full_stack: within the accepted MOVE rate-volatility relief shared paper source, prioritize economically rate-sensitive long-duration sectors (Technology, Communication Services, Consumer Cyclical, Real Estate) ahead of other qualified leaders while preserving the frozen selector, top-2 budget, next-open entry, 10-session exit, costs, cooldown, and notional; the challenger must beat the accepted MOVE v1 helper without any window regression.
interpretation: The volatility-relief stock-leadership source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or answer by retuning VIXY/SPY/QQQ thresholds, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that VIXY relief is still a broad beta/momentum relabel or arrives too late for next-open single-stock continuation after costs.
new_evidence_axis: New gate shape: deterministic rate-sensitive-sector priority ranking inside the accepted MOVE shared paper candidate source, with the MOVE trigger and all eligibility/execution variables locked; prior MOVE experiments tested source admission, shared promotion, core overlap, and exit continuation, not candidate ranking.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter and parity tests before forward observation; live activation would require closed forward replacement-value rows and a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.

policy_bundle.priority_shape: lexicographic sector bucket then unchanged candidate score

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry MOVE sector lists, sector tiers, score bonuses, thresholds, top-N, hold, cooldown, notional, or response functions on the same canonical rows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires at least 30 closed prospective MOVE rows with sector-aware replacement value, a genuinely new issuer-duration field, or a different ranking gate justified before observing outcomes.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The duration-sensitive sector priority did not materially and consistently beat the accepted MOVE v1 helper.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: Treasury rate-volatility relief may precede durable liquid stock leadership

2_history_check.new_axis: New gate shape: deterministic rate-sensitive-sector priority ranking inside the accepted MOVE shared paper candidate source, with the MOVE trigger and all eligibility/execution variables locked; prior MOVE experiments tested source admission, shared promotion, core overlap, and exit continuation, not candidate ranking.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Canonical Gate 1-4; positive aggregate EV/PnL, no window regression, <=0.5pp drawdown drift, >=20 trades across three windows, survival and concentration pass.

prediction.confidence_reason: MOVE v1 is accepted across all three windows and the ranking uses a predeclared economic duration prior with hundreds of qualified candidates, but the champion threshold is high and sector priority may discard stronger idiosyncratic leaders.
